title: MLINE referenced shape-bearing LTYPE and STYLE provider

authority.title: Autodesk LTYPE DXF reference
authority.used_for: Group 74 shape flag, group 75 shape number, group 340 STYLE pointer, and selected per-element parameters.

authority.title: Autodesk STYLE DXF reference
authority.used_for: Group 70 bit 1 identifies a shape STYLE; group 3 names its shape file.

scope.source: Runtime-generated MLINE authority recipe with one group-74 shape segment and a STYLE record marked as a shape; no external fixture is used.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, one dash of 1.5, group 74 values 4 (shape) and 5 (shape plus absolute-rotation bit), group 75 shape number 7, scale 0.75, rotation 0.25 radians on the wire, offsets 0.125/-0.25; no group 9 text value.
scope.style_provider: ComplexShape at source handle 1F3, with group 70 bit 1 and shape-file name ltypeshp.shx.
scope.consumer: The MLINESTYLE references EditDash; source MLINE consumers remain unchanged.

proof.source: Physical source projection verifies the shape STYLE fields, LTYPE segment fields, and group-340 source pointer before import. Typed input binds the segment to the STYLE handle.
proof.output: Physical output verifies the shape STYLE row, all selected LTYPE fields and group 340 equality with the emitted STYLE handle. A fresh read checks the remapped reference, shape flags/number, parameters, and MLINE consumers.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the required STYLE provider causes export refusal and preserves the destination sentinel. Restoring it permits a successful same-adapter retry.

limits: This qualifies transport and source/output STYLE identity for two selected AC1027 shape-LTYPE flag profiles; it preserves the documented absolute-rotation bit but does not prove native orientation or rendering. The named SHX resource is not included or loaded, so shape-number meaning remains unproven.
Other shape numbers/files, combined flags beyond 4/5, multiple segments, field-order variants, other providers, versions, native rendering, and composed document closure remain open.
